fishing: WHEN: Mon Nov 9 evening; mild fall conditions, solid inshore bite continues. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead strong on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats. NEARSHORE: cobia, snapper, tripletail, bonita in 40-50 ft when seas allow. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: guides report inshore bite solid (reds/snook/trout/flounder/sheepshead), FL Sportsman SW low-water reds/snappers with abundant bait.
redtide: FWC Nov 6 status: K. brevis background only in one Pinellas sample past week in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota. Next report Nov 13.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~148 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
